scenario.name: 09-chaos
scenario.description: Everything at once: two instances with rotating SIGKILLs, processor errors before and after charging, cached 500s, webhooks with 10% never delivered, database resets and a blackout, and a flaky outbox receiver (5% HTTP 500).

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Homebrew) on aarch64-apple-darwin25.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), 64-bit
